segment.source: Advanced Usage of Transfer. You can customize the labels of the transfer buttons, the width and height of the columns, and what should be displayed in the footer.
segment.target: Avançado Uso de Transfer. Você pode personalizar o rótulos de o transfer botões, o largura e altura de o colunas, e what should ser exibido em o rodapé.

segment.source: The most basic usage of Transfer involves providing the source data and target keys arrays, plus the rendering and some callback functions.
segment.target: O most básico uso de Transfer involves providing o source dados e target keys arrays, plus o rendering e some callback functions.

segment.source: Bind TargetKeys and SelectedKeys to ObservableCollection values. External collection mutations and Transfer interactions stay synchronized.
segment.target: Bind TargetKeys e SelectedKeys para ObservableCollection values. External collection mutations e Transfer interactions stay synchronized.

segment.source: Use oneWay to make Transfer the one way style.
segment.target: Usar oneWay para make Transfer o um way estilo.

segment.source: Transfer presents candidate items on the left and selected items on the right. It supports one-way movement, filtering, pagination, custom item templates, and tree-backed source data.
segment.target: Transfer presents candidate itens em o esquerda e selecionado itens em o direita. Isso oferece suporte um-way movement, filtering, paginação, personalizado item templates, e árvore-backed source dados.

segment.source: Move items between two collections with optional search, paging, and tree views.
segment.target: Move itens between dois collections com opcional pesquisa, paging, e árvore visualizações.

segment.source: Store a large amount of items with pagination.
segment.target: Store a grande amount de itens com paginação.
